cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, ethereal atmosphere that feels fragile and introspective.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female) and a Mixed Choir (Male and Female).
cards.palette: A resonant grand piano serves as the harmonic backbone, playing arpeggiated figures in the intro and verses, shifting to broad, sustained chords during the choruses to support the vocal weight.
